partners.mechanism_chain: Pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 (HGNC:9721) —DISRUPTS→ Delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate; Delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate —DECREASES→ Proline; Pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 (HGNC:9721) —DECREASES→ Oxidative stress response; Oxidative stress response —LEADS_TO→ Phenotypic features of MONDO:0013051 (HP:0001249); Proline —LEADS_TO→ Phenotypic features of PYCR1-related de Barsy syndrome (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function mutations in PYCR1 impair its ability to catalyze the reduction of Delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate (P5C) to proline. This leads to both a decrease in proline synthesis and an accumulation of P5C, which can be converted to reactive oxygen species, contributing to oxidative stress. The downstream consequences of altered proline levels and increased oxidative stress manifest as the distinct phenotypes of MONDO:0013051 and PYCR1-related de Barsy syndrome.
